lines.zh: 我七对足一起挪动甲壳。
lines.en: My seven pairs of legs shift the shell.

lines.zh: 我在沙底拖出一道浅沟。
lines.en: I drag a shallow trench across the sand.
The seabed mud is soft, so I go slow.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞到石头，咔一声。
lines.en: My shell knocks a rock with a click.
I crawl along the base of the reef.

lines.zh: 一路上我捡别人剩下的。
lines.en: All the way, I pick up what others left.
Antennae probe first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 水压把我的脚步压得很轻。
lines.en: The water's weight muffles my steps.
I round a clump of seagrass.

lines.zh: 甲片一节节地错开又合上。
lines.en: The plates part and close in sequence.
The cold current nudges me sideways.

lines.zh: 我的脚印很快被沙填平。
lines.en: Sand fills my tracks almost at once.
I filter the water slowly through my gills.

lines.zh: 深水没有太阳，我照走不误。
lines.en: No sun this deep; I walk anyway.

lines.zh: 我把一枚贝壳从沙里翻出来
lines.en: I turn a shell up out of the sand.

lines.zh: 暗处的石头滑，我慢一点
lines.en: The stones in the dark are slick, so I slow down.
I wait in a rock crevice for a scent.
My antennae draw slow circles in the water.
Grains of sand settle on my back plates.
I barely move, saving what strength I have.
Something is sinking in the distance.
My shell shows pale in the dark.
A small fish bumps my antenna.
I count the flow of water, slowly.
The cold suits me; I dislike warmth.
I press my belly against the stone.
Now and then one of my legs twitches.
Waiting is the cheapest work on the seabed.
How long have you been holding your breath?

lines.zh: 双双的眼睛看不出情绪。
lines.en: My paired eyes give nothing away.
You are fresher than a shipwreck.
I lift my antennae to scent you.
Do not step on my sand trench.
I turn toward you, very slowly.
You carry the smell of dry land.
My mud is thicker than your boot soles.
I stare, but only out of curiosity.
The water moves when you back away.
Someone is prying at my plates.
My legs have pulled inside.
A thin white crack runs on my shell.
I curl up; only the hard shell faces out.
That one got in through a gap.

lines.zh: 水把我的疼冲淡了一点。
lines.en: The water thins the pain a little.
I move half a meter before stopping.
Do not flip me; I am slow to rise.
My belly segments hate being touched.
Water has seeped into my shell seam.

lines.zh: 那味道像是沉下去的肉。
lines.en: That smells like meat gone down.
Is that bone meal? That interests me.
I shift half a meter toward you.
I slowly reach out with my antennae.
The scraps on the seabed are mine.
No rush; it will not sink fast.
Set it down on the rock for me.
The smell of decay is the most honest.

lines.zh: 我愿意为一口挪动甲壳。
lines.en: For one mouthful I will move this shell.
Come closer; my legs are slow.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是甲片，不是我。
lines.en: You hit plates, not flesh.

lines.zh: 我缩成球，你就推不动了。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and you cannot push me.

lines.zh: 我的边角很硬，小心胫骨。
lines.en: My edges are hard; mind your shin.
I roll half a turn before stopping.
The water squeezes out around us.
Getting out of your way takes me a while.
Do not step on me from above.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，像两块石头。
lines.en: We meet like two stones.

lines.zh: 我的足被你压进沙里了。
lines.en: My legs are pressed into the sand.

lines.zh: 我不是故意的，我转得慢。
lines.en: Not on purpose; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 她在我下方的沙里等着。
lines.en: She waits in the sand below me.

lines.zh: 我把触角搭在她的壳上。
lines.en: I lay my antennae on her shell.
We lie side by side in the crevice.

lines.zh: 深处的冷流把我们围住。
lines.en: The deep cold current closes around us.
Her plates are paler than mine.
I climb onto her back, slowly.
We say almost nothing.
The eggs will sink into the sand.

lines.zh: 海底的相约不需要声音。
lines.en: A seabed appointment needs no sound.
We press together and let the current pass.
You have lifted my whole body.
My legs paddle at the empty water.

lines.zh: 我的壳在你手里很沉吧？
lines.en: My shell is heavy in your hands, is it not?
Set me down gently; my plates can crack.

lines.zh: 你手指碰到了我的腹节。
lines.en: Your fingers found my belly segments.
I have curled up; do not pry me open.
Out of the water I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 你身上有我熟悉的味道。
lines.en: You carry a smell I almost know.
I dangle between your fingers.
Put me back where it is cold.
Something is stirring in the sand.
I turn my antennae into that current.
Something big breathes behind the reef.
My legs grip the stone harder.

lines.zh: 那影子挡住了上面的光。
lines.en: That shape blocks the light from above.
I smell blood and iron.
I flatten myself against the sand.
The plate edges open a little.
I am ready, though I am slow.
Everything down here is large.
I fix on the edge of that dark shape.
My shell is my whole answer.
I turn toward you, unhurried.
My antennae point at your feet.
This blow needs a long time to gather.
My plates have locked shut.
Retreat, and I will not follow far.
I only guard; I do not go looking.
Six legs brace against the sand.

lines.zh: 我的边缘对着你的胫骨。
lines.en: My edge is aimed at your shin.
The water is counting seconds for you.
I close in, one inch at a time.
You think slow means harmless.
Do not put your hand into the crevice.
A plate catches your finger.
I scrape your boot with my edge.

lines.zh: 这一下推得你退了半步。
lines.en: This shove moves you back half a step.
My legs brace and the shell rams.
Little force, but the shell is heavy.

lines.zh: 你听见甲壳相碰的响声。
lines.en: You hear the plates clash.
I am only pushing you away.
Our scuffle turns the sand milky.
After the blow I curl right up.
Next time, leave my belly alone.

lines.zh: 我从沙里翻出来，带起一层尘。
lines.en: I roll out of the sand in a puff of silt.

lines.zh: 我的壳还是软的，先躲着。
lines.en: My shell is still soft; I hide first.
The cold here comforts me.

lines.zh: 我第一次尝到海水的咸。
lines.en: I taste salt water for the first time.

lines.zh: 上方很远有一点光在动。
lines.en: Far above, a speck of light moves.
I crawl downward along a rock seam.
Everything around me smells unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我的触角比身体先长好。
lines.en: My antennae grew in before my body.
The deep water has taken me in.

lines.zh: 我慢慢盖上自己的甲片。
lines.en: I slowly fold my plates over myself.
Scalding water bleaches my plates white.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，甲片散了半秒。
lines.en: Dropped from height, my plates part for half a second.
I live in water, yet this water is too shallow.
The blast reaches me muffled through the seabed.

lines.zh: 箭尖卡在我的甲片之间。
lines.en: An arrowhead is lodged between my plates.
Potion stink seeps into my shell seams.
The seabed is bare; I starve very slowly.

lines.zh: 雷击穿了水，我的足麻了。
lines.en: Lightning pierces the water; my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，我的足抓空。
lines.en: No sand in the void; my legs grip nothing.
